verdict.rationale: FreshBooks documents a REST API with a Reports endpoint and a Journal Entries endpoint. However, the named report types (Invoice Details, Manual Journal Entry, Payments Collected) do not include a general ledger or trial balance, and the Journal Entries endpoint is documented for creating adjustment entries, not exporting the ledger. Nothing in the pack shows full GL or trial balance retrieval, or the open formats it would come in, so this is adjacent support only.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pull the full general ledger and trial balance through a documented API in open formats
